ios.desc:
Downwordly is a word building game that challenges you to make the most out of the letters you have. Not all letters you see are playable! Use your intellect to find the best word you can make while also planning for the future.

Play against your GameCenter friends in turn-based multiplayer!

Play solo with an endless stack of letters!

Try searching for words in Puzzle mode!

Work your way through a new set of 5 layers of tiles every day in the Daily Challenge!

See how you stack up against your friends and the world on the leaderboards.

=========
LAYER TWO
=========



• Solo Versus - Test your skills against four different difficulties of computer opponents.
• 50 new Puzzles
• 8 new themes
• Customize your theme and app icon
• Compete on 2 new leaderboards


What's the longest word you can make?

quotes.text:
Outside of the day job, trying to scrape together some projects that scratch whatever itch I have at the moment.

I'm trying to learn kanji and it was a fun exercise to learn how to render svg in unity so I made a free iOS and Android app:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kanji-book/id1532844605

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bmalicoat.kanjibook&hl=en_US&gl=US

More recently during the pandemic, I wanted a simple way to stay connected to friends and family so I made an async multiplayer word game, Downwordly. I was super psyched when Apple made it game of the day a few months back! Still have to learn how to market it in non-scummy ways :)

https://www.downwordly.com/

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/downwordly/id1544633266#?platform=iphone

Coming to Android very soon!
